title: P2.14 Bound Foundation file and directory capture before allocation
description: Measured at dd2a833: foundation-workspace-capture-node.ts stats then performs unbounded readFileSync, and readdirSync eagerly allocates while maxEntries counts only files. Replace these with bounded reads/enumeration that enforce caps before untrusted allocation even under file-growth races.
definitionOfDone: A red-first race grows a file after stat beyond the byte cap; capture refuses with exact size-limit code/layer without allocating/returning the oversized body.
File reads use bounded chunks and stop after at most cap plus the minimal sentinel byte; short reads preserve exact content/digest.
Directory enumeration enforces a total entry cap including directories before building an unbounded name array.
Tests cover deep/wide trees, symlinks, disappearing files, and growth/shrink races with deterministic refusal attribution.
Runner workspace tests run standalone with nonzero counts.
taskRails: A pre-read stat is advisory, not an allocation bound.
Do not read the whole file or directory and check afterward.
Missing/racy evidence remains UNKNOWN/refused rather than partially admitted.

Add scanner arms that (a) grow a file after stat/read-open past the remaining aggregate cap and require exactly RUNNER_FOUNDATION_CAPTURE_BYTE_LIMIT at RUNNER_WORKSPACE_CAPTURE with no proof, (b) shrink a file mid-read and require RUNNER_FOUNDATION_CAPTURE_IDENTITY_SWAPPED at that layer, (c) remove it between stat and open and require RUNNER_FOUNDATION_CAPTURE_PATH_UNREADABLE, and (d) use a tree where the file count fits but directories make maxEntries overflow and require RUNNER_FOUNDATION_CAPTURE_ENTRY_LIMIT. Preserve the existing deep-tree and real symlink/junction arms, but replace their silent host-inapplicable return with a deterministic injected-SYMLINK fallback so the reason-code/layer assertion always executes. Assert every hostile table has a literal nonzero case count and that each race hook fires exactly once. Run the focused file and record the expected red named assertions before production edits.

implementationPlan.description: Make the filesystem port allocation-safe. In `FoundationCaptureFsPort`, change `listDirectory` to accept a validated maximum additional-entry count and return at most that count plus one sentinel; change `readHandle` to accept a validated byte count and return a discriminated bounded result containing either overflow or exact byteLength/sha256, without introducing a new root export. In `createNodeFoundationCaptureFs`, replace eager `readdirSync` with `opendirSync`/`readSync` iteration capped at N+1 and closed in `finally`; replace `readFileSync` with a fixed-size `readSync` loop that continues across short reads, updates SHA-256 incrementally, never accumulates the body, and after exactly maxBytes reads at most one sentinel byte. Reject nonsafe/negative/over-ceiling adapter bounds before allocation and keep diagnostics non-secret.

Partial admission — every refusal is a terminal return; `state.files` never escapes a failed scan. Short-read truncation — only count 0 ends the loop. Concurrency — state is per-call, the scan is synchronous, nothing shared.
